title: spoonerism
blurb: asked for a bot that posts every spoonerism to Bluesky — that needs an account and a stored app password this build can't wire up, so instead: every spoonerism it would post, made literal. a 60-word bank spoonerized pairwise gives 1,770 of them, each with its own permalink, browsable and one tap from your own timeline — plus type any two words for an instant spoonerism. @heartpunk.com asked for the bot, or the closest thing.
